sources: cholera_guidance
https://www.gov.uk/guidance/cholera
UKHSA cholera guidance
cholera epidemiology, transmission, symptoms, diagnosis and prevention
The guidance covers cholera epidemiology, transmission, clinical presentation and prevention.
It directs healthcare professionals to current diagnostic and public-health management routes.
cholera_green_book
https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/cholera-the-green-book-chapter-14
UKHSA cholera Green Book chapter
cholera immunisation information for public-health and travel-health professionals
The chapter provides cholera immunisation information for public-health professionals.
Vaccination use depends on current destination risk, individual assessment and programme guidance.
leptospirosis_guidance
https://www.gov.uk/guidance/leptospirosis
UKHSA leptospirosis guidance
leptospirosis transmission, clinical features, diagnosis and prevention
The guidance describes leptospirosis exposure routes, symptoms, diagnosis and prevention.
Risk assessment should consider animal, freshwater, occupational and travel exposure histories.
leptospirosis_form
https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/leptospirosis-request-form
UKHSA leptospirosis laboratory request form
submission of diagnostic specimens for specialist leptospirosis testing
The publication provides the request form used for specialist leptospirosis testing.
Valid interpretation requires appropriate specimens, clinical information, exposure history and timing.
chikungunya_guidance
https://www.gov.uk/guidance/chikungunya
UKHSA chikungunya guidance
chikungunya epidemiology, transmission, symptoms, diagnosis and prevention
The guidance covers mosquito-borne chikungunya infection, clinical features and prevention.
UK assessment depends on travel history, current outbreak information and laboratory evidence.
chikungunya_epidemiology
https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/chikungunya-epidemiology-in-england-wales-and-northern-ireland
UKHSA chikungunya epidemiology publication
laboratory-confirmed chikungunya surveillance in England, Wales and Northern Ireland
The publication provides epidemiological data on laboratory-confirmed chikungunya cases.
Reported trends must be read with travel history, reporting period and surveillance methodology.
chikungunya_hairs_landing
https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/hairs-risk-assessment-chikungunya-virus
UKHSA HAIRS chikungunya risk assessment
qualitative assessment of chikungunya risk to the UK population
The publication presents a Human Animal Infections and Risk Surveillance assessment for chikungunya.
The assessment records evidence, uncertainty and the stated UK population risk at publication time.
chikungunya_hairs_detail
https://www.gov.uk/government/publications/hairs-risk-assessment-chikungunya-virus/qualitative-assessment-of-the-risk-that-chikungunya-virus-presents-to-the-uk-population
UKHSA detailed chikungunya HAIRS assessment
likelihood and impact of chikungunya exposure for the UK population
The detailed assessment evaluates pathways by which chikungunya could affect the UK population.
Its conclusions are qualitative and depend on vector presence, travel, transmission and current evidence.
vhf_collection
https://www.gov.uk/government/collections/viral-haemorrhagic-fevers-epidemiology-characteristics-diagnosis-and-management
UKHSA viral haemorrhagic fever collection
VHF epidemiology, characteristics, diagnosis, testing and management
The collection brings together official resources for viral haemorrhagic fevers.
It links acute-hospital risk assessment, imported-fever testing and disease-specific information.
